facts.label: 原厂镜像字节、分区与实际结果

nativeObservations: [emu] stop: Halted — 800000000 insns in 2.8s wall = 280.8 Minsn/s; emulated 5.000s (800000000 cycles); 0 exceptions, 12153 interrupts

[waveshare-c6-touch-amoled132] CO5300 466x466 RAMWR=20 pixels=868624 active=true MADCTL=c0 rejected=0/0; source-specific digital touch/control; raw contact coordinates; SD absent; RF/audio/analog rails/private ID/TE/physical touch registration unverified

value.factory: Exact original image/member verified; native outcome is revision-specific and partial

facts.label: 来源冲突与采用依据
value: Official physical CO5300 identity is retained although BSP source class is named SH8601. Factory Lvgl_PortInit writes MADCTL C0h after its init table; window gap6 is source-specific.
Exact board has no TF socket, IMU, RTC or AXP2101; neighbouring models do not supply invented peripherals.

Touch source reads count02 and raw12-bit coordinates03..06, then computes466-rawX/Y. Runtime exposes bounded raw contacts, not guessed calibration; source off-by-one edge and physical registration remain unresolved.
Copied BSP BATT_STAT GPIO21 conflicts with real LCD reset21; no invented battery-status route is added.

Manufacturer STEP contains all408 native parts. Emissive diameter33.55, optical viewing33.75, trim34.3 and cover36.4 mm are distinguished. Native BOOT/PWR topology mapping is not proven, so buttons stay unbound in3D.

limitations: Native manufacturer CAD revision may differ from current production. No hardware fit or browser WebGL acceptance.
The emissive face is projected above the native cover solely to show the live framebuffer; that rendering offset is not glass thickness.
Uncolored native components use neutral grey; no fabricated silkscreen or hidden battery.
Published33.75 mm viewing and native33.55 mm emissive diameters are not conflated. The physical cover is36.4 mm, trim34.3 mm.

Native switch positions are preserved. Exact photographic BOOT/PWR-to-topology registration is unverified, so the3D switches remain unbound while source-backed GPIO9/GPIO1 controls remain available in the workbench.
